Figure 3:Overview of Prior-Art Agentic Search Trajectory Synthesis (PASS) for PatEx-SynData.
(A) Visit-guided, relevance-aware rollout segmentation divides trajectories into semantic turns using visits as anchors.rrdenotes reasoning,SSdenotes search,VVdenotes visit,ZZdenotes the returned tool results, andWWdenotes workspace tools, e.g.Write. (B) Hierarchical quality modeling evaluates multidimensional quality.
(C) Tournament-based ranking with rejection sampling for high-quality trajectories.

Table 2:Main results on PatEx-Bench. Score is on a 0–10 scale. Decision Accuracy (Dec.) and Statute F1 (Stat.) evaluate the final examination decision and statutory grounds, respectively. Searched (Search-R), Visited (Visit-R), and Selected (Select-R) report the recall (%) at the corresponding stages. Best results in each column arebolded; second-best results areunderlined.

Table 3:Retrieval results on the Patent Corpus. Sparse and dense retrievers are evaluated using R@KK. For each agent onCodex Harness (w/our standard toolset,i.e., Boolean, BM25 and BGE-M3), we order the patents in its search trajectory and apply the same budgetKKfor a fair comparison.
